title: All About Birds
description: Cornell's standard species encyclopedia — range maps, vocalizations, life history.

title: All About Birds — Northern Goshawk
description: The Cornell species page for the northern goshawk: ID, habitat, behavior, sounds.

title: Animal Diversity Web
description: University of Michigan's species encyclopedia with trait and behavior write-ups.

title: Astola Island — Pakistan's Offshore Haven
description: Pakistan's largest offshore island and a critical nesting site for turtles and seabirds in the Arabian Sea.

title: Audubon Field Guide
description: National Audubon's field-guide content and conservation work.

title: BirdLife International
description: The global partnership of bird conservation NGOs — Red List assessments and Important Bird Areas.

title: Birds of the World
description: The definitive curated species accounts (paywalled, but the flagship of ornithological reference).

title: Chitral National Park
description: Home to markhor, snow leopards, Tibetan wolves and the rare western tragopan — one of Pakistan's most biodiverse corners.

title: CITES
description: The treaty regulating international trade in species — including all the falcons and hawks.

title: Cornell Bird Cams
description: Live camera nests — birds doing bird things, streamed year-round from the Cornell Lab.

title: Dachigam National Park
description: The lifeline of the hangul deer — also black bears, leopards and 150+ bird species in the Kashmir valley.

title: eBird
description: Cornell's citizen-science bird checklist platform — occurrence data that powers modern ornithology.

title: eBird species map — Northern Goshawk
description: Live checklist and distribution data for Accipiter gentilis, from the Cornell database.

title: Falconry in the Valley of the Indus
description: Sir Richard Burton's account of hawking the Indus while a young officer in the East India Company — the volume that sent this archive's falconry shelf running. Scanned, searchable, mine for a shirt-flap of primary detail.

title: GBIF
description: The global biodiversity information facility — species occurrence data at planetary scale.

title: Hangul — Kashmir's Critically Endangered Red Deer
description: The hangul (Kashmir stag), the only surviving red-deer subspecies in South Asia, holds on in Dachigam National Park.

title: HawkWatch International
description: Raptor migration counts and research across the flyways — their migration dashboards are an addiction.

title: Himalayan Brown Bear of Deosai Plains
description: The Deosai National Park in Gilgit-Baltistan protects one of the last high-altitude strongholds of the Himalayan brown bear.

title: Himalayan Monal — Danphe
description: The iridescent monal found across the Himalayas including Azad Kashmir — among the most striking birds on earth.

title: Himalayan Musk Deer
description: The elusive musk deer hunted for its gland — critically endangered across the high Kashmir and Pakistan ranges.

title: iNaturalist
description: Observation platform for every taxon, where a blurry raptor from your phone can get an expert ID.

title: Indus River Dolphin
description: One of the world's rarest mammals — the blind Indus river dolphin, fewer than 2,000 left in the Indus system.

title: International Association for Falconry
description: The federation of national falconry associations, an UNESCO-recognized traditional craft — see 'Falconry' for the wider history.

title: IUCN Pakistan
description: The Pakistan country office of the IUCN — Red List work and conservation policy for AJK and Gilgit-Baltistan.

title: IUCN Red List
description: The global extinction-risk database — look up the conservation status of any goshawk, snow leopard, or shisham.

title: Looking for the Goshawk
description: Conor Jameson's modern search for the northern goshawk across Britain — a field book that reads like a detective story.

title: Macaulay Library
description: Cornell's archive of photos, sound and video — the world's largest media collection of birds.

title: North American Falconers' Association (NAFA)
description: The US/Canada falconry organization — apprentice mentoring, meets, and legal advocacy for the sport.

title: Pakistan's Ramsar Wetland Sites
description: The 19 Ramsar sites — critical staging and wintering habitat for birds migrating from Siberia to Africa.

title: Raptor Research Foundation
description: The scientific society for raptor researchers and the publishers of the Journal of Raptor Research.

title: Raptor Resource Project
description: The falcon-cam project full of nesting cams and restoration programs.

title: RSPB
description: The UK's bird conservation charity — reserve guides and species info.

title: Serengeti Live Cam
description: Live cameras over the Serengeti — lions, elephants and the greatest show on earth, streamed.

title: Snow Leopard Trust
description: The main snow leopard science and community-conservation org across the Himalayas including Pakistan.

title: SORA — Searchable Ornithological Research Archive
description: Free digital archive of ornithological journals — Auk, Condor, Wilson Bulletin and others, fully searchable.

title: Thar & Cholistan — Desert Wildlife
description: Chinkara gazelle, desert foxes and bustards — the surprising biodiversity of Pakistan's sand seas.

title: The British Falconers' Club
description: The UK's flagship falconry club, running since 1927.

title: The Markhor — Pakistan's National Animal
description: The magnificent spiral-horned markhor of Pakistan's north — a conservation success story, endangered to vulnerable.

title: The Natural History of Selborne
description: Gilbert White's 1789 letters on the natural history of his parish — the book that quietly invented ecological natural-history writing.

title: The Northern Goshawk (species text)
description: The accessible species page — taxonomy, range, hunting behavior and the goshawk's role in falconry.

title: The Peregrine Fund
description: The raptor conservation nonprofit — from the peregrine recovery to today's global raptor programs.

title: Tibetan Wolf
description: The key predator of Pakistan's northern alpine ecosystem.

title: US Fish & Wildlife Service
description: Federal wildlife agency; the falconry regulations page and migratory bird oversight are the legal reference here.

title: WWF Pakistan
description: WWF's Pakistan program — the country's key conservation datasets (snow leopard, markhor campaigns).
